hints.sentence: A store charge reaches the app's billing records only when the subscriber next opens the app, so the stores' monthly reports hold charges the records never took in, and they belong to the subscriptions last seen still set to renew.

An iOS network still gets every install's first-48-hour value back and steers what it buys blind by it, so its installs that declined tracking pay at the trial's end nearly as often as its others and then cancel sooner: their revenue per payer does not follow the gap the fully named channels show.

The plan's weekly figures are billed spend and a platform bills only what the week's auction lets it spend of a budget, so the budgets that deliver the plan are larger than its figures, and the installs follow the budgets.
